import.title: Import
import.description: Add your Winamax hand histories and tournament summaries.

drop.title: Drop your Winamax files here
drop.hint: Hand histories and tournament summaries (.txt), or a .zip archive. You can drop a whole folder: importing the same file twice never creates duplicates.
drop.where: On a Mac, Winamax saves them in ~/Library/Application Support/winamax/documents/accounts/<your pseudonym>/history. In the file picker, press ⌘⇧G and paste this path (the Library folder is hidden by default).
drop.nothing: No .txt or .zip file in this selection.

import.ignored: {{count}} file(s) left out: only .txt and .zip files are imported.

clear.title: No leak found
clear.description: Every statistic with enough situations is within the references. Keep importing: new situations will be judged.

groups.confirmedHint: Even allowing for variance, your rate is outside the references.
groups.possibleHint: Your rate is outside the references, but the sample still allows a normal rate.

under.title: {{count}} statistic(s) cannot be judged yet: too few situations

leaks.method: References version {{version}}: online MTTs from €5 to €20, solid regulars, hands with 15 BB or more. A leak is confirmed only when the whole 95 % confidence interval is outside the reference.

tooHigh.title: You play too many hands
tooHigh.why: You enter {{rate}} of pots (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). Too many weak hands end up out of position or dominated after the flop.
tooHigh.work: Tighten your opening and calling ranges, especially early and against raises.

tooLow.title: You play too few hands
tooLow.why: You enter {{rate}} of pots (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). You give up blinds and antes that are easy to win.
tooLow.work: Open wider in late position and defend your big blind more.

tooHigh.title: You raise too often
tooHigh.why: You raise {{rate}} of hands (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). Your raises become easy to re-raise.
tooHigh.work: Keep raises for hands and positions that justify them.

tooLow.title: You do not raise enough
tooLow.why: You raise {{rate}} of hands (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). Without the initiative you win fewer pots without a showdown.
tooLow.work: Enter pots by raising rather than calling, especially when nobody has bet yet.

tooHigh.title: You call much more than you raise
tooHigh.why: {{rate}} of hands are played by calling only (reference up to {{max}}). Calling hands the initiative to opponents.
tooHigh.work: Turn some of your preflop calls into raises or folds.

tooLow.title: Unusual VPIP/PFR gap
tooLow.why: The gap between hands played and hands raised is {{rate}} (reference {{min}}–{{max}}).
tooLow.work: Check that you defend your blinds enough by calling.

tooHigh.title: You open too wide from {{position}}
tooHigh.why: You open {{rate}} of the times it is folded to you in {{position}} (reference {{min}}–{{max}}).
tooHigh.work: Drop the weakest hands from your opening range in that position.

tooLow.title: You open too little from {{position}}
tooLow.why: You open {{rate}} of the times it is folded to you in {{position}} (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). These are profitable pots you leave.
tooLow.work: Add playable hands (small pairs, suited connectors, suited aces) to your range in that position.

tooHigh.title: You limp too much
tooHigh.why: You enter by calling {{rate}} of the times it is folded to you (reference up to {{max}}). In MTTs, limping leads to multiway pots out of position.
tooHigh.work: When nobody has entered, raise or fold.

tooHigh.title: You steal too much
tooHigh.why: You open {{rate}} of the times it is folded to you in the cutoff, button or small blind (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). The blinds will start re-raising you.
tooHigh.work: Keep a stealing range you can defend against a re-raise.

tooLow.title: You do not steal the blinds enough
tooLow.why: You open {{rate}} of the times it is folded to you in the cutoff, button or small blind (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). Antes make these steals very profitable in tournaments.
tooLow.work: Open more often in late position when it is folded to you.

tooHigh.title: You 3-bet too much
tooHigh.why: You 3-bet {{rate}} of the times you face a raise (reference {{min}}–{{max}}).
tooHigh.work: Keep 3-bets for your best hands and a few well-chosen bluffs.

tooLow.title: You do not 3-bet enough
tooLow.why: You 3-bet {{rate}} of the times you face a raise (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). Opponents open without fear.
tooLow.work: Re-raise your strong hands instead of calling, and add a few bluffs in position.

tooHigh.title: You fold too much to 3-bets
tooHigh.why: You fold {{rate}} of your opens to a re-raise (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). You can be re-raised with anything.
tooHigh.work: Defend more: call in position or 4-bet your best hands.

tooLow.title: You do not fold enough to 3-bets
tooLow.why: You fold only {{rate}} of your opens to a re-raise (reference {{min}}–{{max}}).
tooLow.work: Open hands that can continue, and let the others go against a 3-bet.

tooHigh.title: You c-bet the flop too much
tooHigh.why: You bet {{rate}} of flops as the preflop raiser (reference {{min}}–{{max}}).
tooHigh.work: Check more on flops that hit your opponent's range.

tooLow.title: You do not c-bet the flop enough
tooLow.why: You bet {{rate}} of flops as the preflop raiser (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). You give up the initiative too soon.
tooLow.work: Bet small more often on flops that favour your range.

tooHigh.title: You go to showdown too often
tooHigh.why: You reach showdown in {{rate}} of the flops you see (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). You call down too many medium hands.
tooHigh.work: Let go of more medium hands against strong turn and river pressure.

tooLow.title: You give up too often after the flop
tooLow.why: You reach showdown in {{rate}} of the flops you see (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). You are too easy to push off a hand.
tooLow.work: Defend your medium hands more against single bets.

tooHigh.title: You win a lot at showdown
tooHigh.why: You win {{rate}} of showdowns (reference {{min}}–{{max}}): often a sign you only get there with very strong hands.
tooHigh.work: Check you are not folding too many medium hands earlier.

tooLow.title: You lose too much at showdown
tooLow.why: You win {{rate}} of showdowns (reference {{min}}–{{max}}). You go too far with beaten hands.
tooLow.work: Review your river calls: a medium hand facing a big bet is often beaten.
